suite: V-VECTOR-01 — Model migration: compatible/incompatible partition migration, dimension/hash/tokenizer mismatch, dual-partition transition, old-generation deletion, and Partial retrieval strategy behavior

sections.name: Compatible model migration
sections.description: Same dimension/encoding, different source_revision → both partitions accepted; vectors writable to each. Two distinct partition_ids coexist.

sections.name: Incompatible model migration (different dimension rejected)
sections.description: A manifest with dimension=768 fails manifest.validate() with WrongDimension. ensure_partition also rejects it as PartitionError::InvalidManifest.

sections.name: Dimension mismatch: wrong vector element count rejected
sections.description: validate_raw_vector and upsert_v2 reject vectors with wrong element count (0, 383, 384+, 768).
assertions: upsert_v2 with 768-element vector → storage error mentioning dimension/validation

sections.name: Hash mismatch: orphan partition_id rejected
sections.description: upsert_v2 with a partition_id not registered via ensure_partition fails with FK constraint violation. Different source_revision → new distinct partition slot.
assertions: upsert with unregistered partition_id → FOREIGN KEY constraint error
different source_revision → different partition_id (new partition slot)

sections.name: Tokenizer mismatch behavior documented
sections.description: Partition key is model_id:source_revision. Different tokenizer_sha256 on same source_revision may or may not cause SchemaMismatch depending on field coverage in ensure_partition. Test documents actual behavior.
assertions: tokenizer_sha256 difference with same model_id:source_revision → behavior documented (SchemaMismatch or silently accepted per design)

sections.name: Zero-norm vector rejected
sections.description: All-zero 384-element vector has L2 norm=0 and is rejected by validate_raw_vector and upsert_v2.

sections.name: NaN vector rejected
sections.description: Vectors with NaN at index 0 or index 42 are rejected with NaNAtIndex.

sections.name: Inf vector rejected
sections.description: +Inf and -Inf values at any index are rejected with InfAtIndex.

sections.name: Wrong 1536-byte count rejected
sections.description: Vectors with 0, 383, or 385 elements (0/1532/1540 bytes) are all rejected with DimensionMismatch.

sections.name: Dual partition transition
sections.description: Both old (v1) and new (v2) partitions are simultaneously operational during the migration window. Writes to each are isolated; no cross-contamination.
assertions: old and new partition record sets are disjoint

sections.name: Old-generation deletion after migration completes
sections.description: After migration completes, old partition vectors and registry row are hard-deleted. New partition remains intact. Authority rows (events_v2) are unaffected.
assertions: DELETE FROM mem_vectors_v2 WHERE partition_id = old_pid succeeds
DELETE FROM embedding_partitions WHERE partition_id = old_pid succeeds
old partition registry row count = 0 after deletion
old partition vector count = 0 after deletion

sections.name: Remaining-strategy Partial behavior
sections.description: CapabilityMatrix reports Partial with unavailable_strategies=['vector'] when vector strategy is unavailable. RRF fusion with vector Unavailable: FTS score is NOT redistributed — equals w_fts/(k+1) exactly.
assertions: fuse_candidates with vector Unavailable → exactly 1 result
vector contribution = 0.0 when strategy is Unavailable
